THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Minecraft Cookies & Cream Sandwich Cookie Creami

Chocolate cookies-and-cream protein Creami with brownie and sandwich-cookie mix-ins and a purple marshmallow-creme finish. 385 calories and 46g protein for the complete pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min active + overnight freeze
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~385 cal | ~46g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Black cocoa drives the cookies-and-cream color and flavor. Do not silently swap it for regular cocoa.

Ingredients

CREAMI BASE

  • 1 cup 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 1 serving unflavored whey isolate
  • 1 tsp black cocoa powder
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 2 tbsp monk fruit sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum (level measure)
  • 1 pinch salt

MIX-INS (after the first spin)

  • 1/3 Cookie Monster protein brownie
  • 1 chocolate sandwich cookie

PURPLE TOPPING

  • 2 tbsp marshmallow creme
  • Natural red and blue food coloring, as needed

Allergens: dairy, wheat, gluten. Packaged labels vary. Verify the current whey isolate, brownie, sandwich cookie, and marshmallow creme labels before publishing final allergen or diet tags. The brownie and sandwich cookie may add egg, soy, tree nuts, or peanuts depending on the current product formula; verify the physical packages.

You want a chocolate cookies-and-cream whole-pint Creami with a fun purple Minecraft finish and enough protein to work as a Powerup. Part of the CrumblCreamiCut series recreating current Crumbl flavors.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND BASE. Combine the 2% ultra-filtered milk, whey isolate, black cocoa, vanilla, monk fruit, guar gum, and salt. Blend until completely smooth with no cocoa or whey clumps.
  2. 2.POUR + FREEZE. Pour into a Creami pint without exceeding the max-fill line. Freeze upright and level overnight.
  3. 3.FIRST SPIN. Process the frozen pint on Regular Ice Cream. If it stays powdery, run one no-liquid Respin before adding mix-ins.
  4. 4.ADD MIX-INS. Cut a center well and add one-third of the Cookie Monster brownie and one chocolate sandwich cookie, then run Mix-In.
  5. 5.MAKE PURPLE CREME. Stir natural red and blue food coloring into 2 tablespoons of marshmallow creme until it turns an even purple.
  6. 6.SCOOP + DRIZZLE. Scoop the Creami into a bowl and drizzle the purple marshmallow creme over the top. Eat immediately for the intended texture.

Keys to success

  • Freeze the pint upright and level overnight.
  • Use Regular Ice Cream for the first cycle, not Lite.

If something fails

Base is too light in color: Confirm a full teaspoon of black cocoa. Black cocoa is what gives the cookies-and-cream look; regular cocoa reads milk-chocolate brown.

Powdery after Regular Ice Cream: Run one no-liquid Respin before adding the brownie and cookie.

Marshmallow drizzle seizes on the cold Creami: Warm the marshmallow creme slightly and drizzle in thin lines; it sets fast on the frozen scoops.

Texture is gummy: The guar gum was likely heaped. Use a level 1/8 teaspoon.

Purple looks muddy: Use more blue than red and add color a drop at a time; too much red pulls it toward brown against the chocolate.

Storage and reheating

Store: Keep the unprocessed base frozen upright and level. Color the marshmallow creme and process only when ready to eat.

Reheat: N/A. If the processed base is powdery, use a no-liquid Respin before adding the mix-ins.

Lasts: The frozen pre-spin pint keeps up to one week. The finished pint is best immediately after Mix-In and drizzle.

~385 cal | ~46g protein.

Flavor target

First bite: chocolate cookies-and-cream from the black-cocoa base and sandwich-cookie pieces. Middle: creamy ultra-filtered-milk and whey body. Finish: soft brownie chunks and a sweet marshmallow-creme drizzle on top.
